summary: Lets an IMAP client send its initial authentication data along with the AUTHENTICATE command, instead of waiting for the server to ask for it. This saves one round trip at the start of a session, which matters on slow or high-latency networks. It is a standards-track IMAP extension.

eli5.summary: Instead of knocking and waiting to be asked who you are, you say your name as you knock, which saves a back-and-forth.

questions: how to save a round trip in imap authentication
